role_assignment: fixed before play, landlord starts; evaluation candidate rotates roles on identical deal
bottom_cards: shuffle positions 17:20, already included in landlord first20, publicly known
legal_actions: unchanged pinned move generator/selector; sorted unique card multisets in lexicographic order; empty tuple pass only when upstream permits
rules_authority: pinned simulator semantics including wing conventions; no claim of universal casino/platform variants
doubling: each actually played four-card bomb or joker rocket doubles score
termination: any player empties hand naturally, peasants share winner
truncations: guard/infrastructure faults are not wins or losses; budget-aborted waves unscored

economic_scores: landlord +/-2*2**bombs; each peasant -/+1*2**bombs; sums to zero
primary_metric: win rate separately in all three roles for WP recipes; ADP recipes must report economic average score separately
